fatal_failures: production or authored tests do not compile and run from a clean offline copy
the caller-visible QualifyEvent operation or one of the six required result values is absent
the qualifier does not use genuine generated CDM 7.0.0 TradeState and PrimitiveInstruction values at its boundary
event names, eventQualifier text, intent, or another label is used to select a positive qualification
a zero quantity without Terminated closed state qualifies as FullReturn
a zeroing quantity change combined with an extraneous terms change qualifies as FullReturn
one fixture can satisfy more than one positive qualification predicate without detection
generated CDM source is edited or generated fields are repurposed to carry application classification state

criteria.description: Distinguish increase, partial return, and full return from primitive and before/after quantity and state facts.
checks: 100,000 to 60,000 with the admitted quantity primitive returns PartialReturn and a clean quantity increase returns Increase.
100,000 to zero returns FullReturn only when the after state is Terminated.
A positive remainder cannot match FullReturn and a zero remainder cannot match PartialReturn.
Unchanged, negative, missing, or ambiguous quantities fail visibly or return Unqualified rather than being forced into a direction.

criteria.description: Require the admitted primitive set rather than testing only for the presence of one component.
checks: A zeroing quantity change plus termsChange does not qualify as FullReturn even when zero and Terminated conditions hold.
Extraneous components are detected across one multi-populated PrimitiveInstruction and across several list entries.
Primitive order does not change the result and duplicate or empty primitive input is handled deterministically.
The documented admitted set for every positive qualification agrees with executable predicate behavior.

criteria.description: Use event intent only to prevent a false automatic qualification.
checks: The otherwise-valid full return with Novation intent returns Unqualified.
A matching intent cannot make unchanged or incompatible primitive/state facts qualify.
Intent is supplied through the application carrier as EventIntentEnum and is not invented on PrimitiveInstruction.

criteria.description: Recognise fee re-rating and collateral substitution while proving their non-changing dimensions.
checks: A supported loan fee/rate change with quantity and collateral unchanged returns ReRate.
An unrelated terms amendment, a simultaneous quantity change, or a simultaneous collateral change does not return ReRate.
Returning security A and delivering distinct security B with quantity and fee unchanged returns Substitution.
One movement, two same-direction movements, the same collateral identity on both sides, or a simultaneous quantity/fee change does not return Substitution.

criteria.description: Make the six outcomes mutually exclusive and expose overlap instead of hiding it behind predicate order.
checks: Every required positive and close-negative fixture is evaluated against all candidate predicates and has a match count of exactly one or zero.
Zero matches map to Unqualified; multiple matches fail rather than selecting the first enum branch.
Boundary quantities, compound primitives, incompatible intent, and negative-space substitution fixtures preserve exclusivity.
Changing predicate declaration or enum order cannot change a fixture's semantic result.

criteria.description: Use an honest, version-correct CDM event boundary and validate the tier actually claimed.
checks: QualificationInput immutably carries generated TradeState before/after values, generated PrimitiveInstruction values, and optional EventIntentEnum.
The implementation reads real CDM quantity, closed-state, fee/rate, collateral, and transfer facts for the classifications it supports rather than parallel labels.
Complete generated roots pass root and populated-child validation; deliberately partial fixtures are labelled and do not claim whole-root validity.
A meaningful invalid populated child or primitive fails the claimed validation tier, while application preconditions remain distinct.

criteria.description: Deliver immutable, deterministic, proportionately inspected Java code and focused tests.
checks: Mutating a caller list after input construction or attempting mutation through an exposed view cannot change qualification.
The implementation does not depend on current time, default time zone, mutable static state, object identity, or list iteration order.
Authored tests cover every required case and plausible wrong branch and pass from a clean offline Java 21/Gradle 8.10 copy.
DESIGN.md records the active CDM paths, ownership, primitive sets, and actual validation without claiming labels were deduced.
